source_scan_boundary: This supplement adjudicates only the three registered source gaps on printed p81 and adjacent context. It does not claim a full independent extraction of every sentence on printed p81 or p82. Direct re-review refines the original W05-SG-002 image-resolution note: the page visibly prints “有是非词不达意讼”, which is preserved literally; the intended semantic correction and the condition scope of the following alternative remain unresolved. The original gap artifact is preserved unchanged as historical provenance.
major_findings: W05-SG-001 splits into two source-explicit conditions within the inherited 子午廉贞天相 context: financial loss under 刑忌夹印 or 廉贞化忌, and a separate 煞曜空劫 dispute condition. The latter is not made dependent on the former, and the combined wording is not split into alternative triggers without source support.

W05-SG-002 is only partially resolved: the clear difficulty-accumulating-wealth clause is promoted. Direct page-image re-review refines the original gap artifact's image-resolution note: the literal printed sequence is “有是非词不达意讼”, not the normalized wording “有是非词讼”. The literal is preserved and not semantically emended; the scope of the surface-glamour alternative remains open.
W05-SG-003 preserves both 横发横破 and the explicit moderating qualifier “性质较为和缓” without numeric intensity or probability.
The original W05 candidate-batch source-gap artifact remains unchanged as historical provenance; this closure ledger records current dispositions.
